Text.Text: The enclave has its halls back. Stand where you are needed, Guardian. You've finished my Aegis Eternal trials. I have no further work for you here.
The guardian trials require rank 50 in Lightsaber. Reach that rank, then return. 'While I stand, none fall' is a promise that needs practice.

The guardians have barred the trial halls and turned their oath toward protecting only themselves. Recover their trial slate so we can begin setting that right. Defeat six Guardian Master Adepts in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Guardian Master Enclave Trial Slate; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Library. I'll give you the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Aegis Eternal.

Here's the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls Key. Use 'Jedi Enclave Trial Halls' in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Library. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Guardian Master Adepts, then return with the Guardian Master Enclave Trial Slate.

Guardian Master is the name of the school you're confronting. The technique these trials qualify you to learn is Aegis Eternal. Recovering its records and defeating its master will show me you're ready for that training.

Use 'Jedi Enclave Trial Halls' in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Library. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Guardian Master Adepts in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Guardian Master Enclave Trial Slate; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Library.

Worry is fitting. Fear is optional. They fight as guardians are taught, shield-first, patient, punishing every rash step. But they guard only each other now, and that is weakness dressed as devotion. Do not let them draw you into the dark between the lamps, and do not hate them. Pity keeps a better edge.
Defeat six Guardian Master Adepts in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Guardian Master Enclave Trial Slate; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Library.
You've defeated six Guardian Master Adepts. Let me see the Guardian Master Enclave Trial Slate.
The training record is back. We can see what went wrong. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists took a focus shard from the meditation shrine. Bring it back to the enclave. Defeat five Guardian Master Specialists in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Guardian Master Kyber Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Library.
Your key still grants access to Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Defeat five Guardian Master Specialists to secure the Guardian Master Kyber Focus Shard, then return to me.

Themselves. Their pride. The memory of being needed. A guardian without a charge will invent one, and they have invented a fortress where a school should stand. Five shields locked in a ring, facing out at a world that asked nothing of them but their word.

Kyber remembers what is asked of it. That shard sat in the shrine for three generations, and every guardian who knelt before a trial asked it the same thing: let me be enough. It hums with all those askings. In the specialists' keeping it is learning a new question, let them be less, and kyber learns what it is taught. Bring it home before the lesson takes.

As one wall. They will let you spend yourself against them and answer only when you tire, so do not oblige them. Strike, withdraw, make the wall keep choosing a front. A ring of shields defends poorly when it cannot decide where you are. And respect their patience. It is the true veteran in that room.
Defeat five Guardian Master Specialists in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Guardian Master Kyber Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Library.
You've defeated five Guardian Master Specialists. Let me see the Guardian Master Kyber Focus Shard.
That equipment no longer serves their drills. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden holds the halls against the people she once protected. Recover her fractured sigil and end her watch. Defeat the Guardian Master Warden in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Guardian Master Fractured Trial Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Library. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Guardian Master Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Guardian Master Fractured Trial Sigil.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Guardian Master Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

The warden's sigil witnesses every trial held in these halls; no rite above the third ward stands without it. It fractured in the hour she sealed that ward, for such seals answer to the oath and not to the officer. She wears the halves fitted together, as though a broken witness could still testify. Recovering it is not trophy-taking. It is returning the court to the law.

Grief, I believe, though she would name it clarity. She kept the third ward through the raid years and lost students she had sworn over. Somewhere in that loss she decided the only charge worth guarding is the guard itself. It is the oath folded inward until it faces nothing. I prayed for a long time that words could answer her. I have stopped.

Defeat the Guardian Master Warden in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Guardian Master Fractured Trial Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Library. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Guardian Master Warden. Let me see the Guardian Master Fractured Trial Sigil.
The warden's watch is over. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

The four ward-captains still carry the council's authority to teach. Take their council chit out of their keeping. Defeat four members of the Guardian Master Inner Circle in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Guardian Master Council Trial Chit; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Library.
Your key still grants access to Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Defeat four members of the Guardian Master Inner Circle to secure the Guardian Master Council Trial Chit, then return to me.

A small thing. Bronzium, plain as a door key, with the whole authority of the enclave council pressed into it. It certifies that what these halls teach is the guardian's discipline and not a private doctrine. Their claim to it is the difference between four traitors and, in their own telling, four custodians. Take it back, and their telling ends.

Corners. Each guards the next, so every strike you land is answered from your blind side. Break the square and they are only four strong blades; leave it whole and they are one creature with eight arms. If companions stand with you, set them to pull two corners apart. The square cannot mourn its shape and fight you at once.

They stood my own investiture, all four. When I spoke the fifth line, it was their blades arched above me. I tell you this not to soften your hand but to steady mine, and because you should know what it is you end. Not villains. Guardians who forgot that holding means holding for someone. Write that on the deep ward wall when it is done, if you have the heart.

Defeat four members of the Guardian Master Inner Circle in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Guardian Master Council Trial Chit; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Library.
You've defeated four members of the Guardian Master Inner Circle. Let me see the Guardian Master Council Trial Chit.
Their instructors no longer hold the authority to teach. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The Guardian Master Paragon is the last guardian holding the halls. Defeat him in the Saber Trial Chamber to complete the oath's trials. Defeat the Guardian Master Paragon in Dantooine, Saber Trial Chamber. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Library; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dantooine, Saber Trial Chamber, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Guardian Master Paragon. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

The finest keeper of the oath these halls ever raised. Every line kept, every charge brought home, every ward held through years that broke lesser sentinels. Every oath but one. When the students turned inward, the Paragon was sworn to answer for the failure, and instead sealed the doors and mounted guard over the failure itself. A perfect watch, kept over nothing at all. That is the one broken line, and it has been breaking further every year since.

Don't spend the whole fight exhausting yourself against his guard. Bring companions, share the pressure, and support whoever he turns on. Keep enough strength to answer an opening when it comes. The oath is to keep each other standing, not to prove you can do it alone.

I recommend two companions against the Guardian Master Paragon. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.

Defeat the Guardian Master Paragon in Dantooine, Saber Trial Chamber. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Library; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Guardian Master Paragon. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The enclave has its halls back. Stand where you are needed, Guardian. You've earned the right to train Aegis Eternal. Your final payment is ready.
Tell me the charge once more.
I'll defeat six Guardian Master Adepts.
How does this school relate to Aegis Eternal?
How do I reach the outer ward?
Six adepts. Should I be worried?
I can't swear to it today.
Here's the Guardian Master Enclave Trial Slate.
Go back. I have another question.
I'll defeat five Guardian Master Specialists.
What do the specialists guard in there?
What is the focus shard to your order?
How do five veteran shields fight?
Not yet. That line is heavier than the first.
Here's the Guardian Master Kyber Focus Shard.
Let me ask something else.
I'll defeat the Guardian Master Warden.
Would you recommend bringing help?
What is the sigil she carries?
What turned the warden?
Not until two I trust can stand with me.
Here's the Guardian Master Fractured Trial Sigil.
Back to the deep ward. Ask me again.
I'll defeat four members of the Guardian Master Inner Circle.
What is the council chit?
How do the four of them fight?
Were they yours, once?
Not yet. A square with no unguarded side wants more than I have today.
Here's the Guardian Master Council Trial Chit.
Speak the whole charge again.
I'll face the Guardian Master Paragon and report back.
Who is the Paragon?
How do I fight a perfect guard?
What happens to the halls when it's done?
Not yet. If the Paragon is to see me guarding someone, it must be the right someone.
The Guardian Master Paragon is defeated. Here's my report.
